subject: Copywriting
title: Voice of America
description: A short lesson to help you apply Voice of America.

hook.text: Voice of America broadcast news behind the Iron Curtain in 40 languages.

buildup.text: VOA launched in 1942 and expanded during the Cold War.

discovery.text: VOA's power was credibility. It reported US failures alongside successes.

twist.text: The Soviets spent millions jamming VOA signals.

climax.text: When the Berlin Wall fell in 1989, many credited Western broadcasts for keeping hope alive.

punchline.text: 40 languages, millions of listeners. Honest words crossed the Iron Curtain.

quiz.question: What made Voice of America more credible than Soviet radio?
options: It reported US failures alongside successes
